svg.text: How the CoE Dashboard is built

one email per person, listing their quiet open items · company addresses only
1 · The data: Finance keeps its Excel spreadsheets on SharePoint, as always
2 · The engine reads them (never edits them) and prepares the figures
3 · Figures, comments and their history are kept in private Azure Storage
4 · Leaders log in to the dashboard with their company account
5 · They read the figures with a one-hour pass and add comments
6 · Quiet open items: the owner gets a reminder from one Outlook mailbox
7 · Every Saturday a copy of the whole dashboard is saved to SharePoint
Every refresh, reminder and error is logged · then the story repeats
